svg.title: Trait seams - provided (lollipop) and required (socket) interfaces

g.text: Trait seams - provided (lollipop) and required (socket) interfaces
The engine never names a concrete provider: it receives
ProviderSet = llm, fast_llm, transcription, vision, ocr,
NullStore is used for meetings that are not retained;
HashingEmbedder is the fallback when ProviderSet.embeddings is None.
CollectingSink, MemoryStore) implement the same traits (omitted).
